require 'fileutils'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'tempfile'

module SearchIndexer
  ROLES = { admin: 3, editor: 2, viewer: 1 }.freeze
  INDEX_BASE = '/var/lib/search_index'
  TEMP_BASE = '/tmp/search_indexer'

  class AccessControl
    def initialize(user_role)
      @role_level = ROLES.fetch(user_role.to_sym, 0)
    end

    def can_write?
      @role_level >= ROLES[:editor]
    end

    def can_admin?
      @role_level >= ROLES[:admin]
    end

    def can_read?
      @role_level >= ROLES[:viewer]
    end
  end

  class DocumentProcessor
    def initialize(collection_name, acl)
      @collection = sanitize_collection(collection_name)
      @acl = acl
      @index_dir = File.join(INDEX_BASE, @collection)
      @staging_dir = File.join(TEMP_BASE, @collection, Process.pid.to_s)
    end

    def sanitize_collection(name)
      clean = name.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid collection name' if clean.empty?
      clean
    end

    def prepare_staging
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@staging_dir)
      @staging_dir
    end

    def index_document(doc_id, content, metadata = {})
      raise 'Write access denied' unless @acl.can_write?

      prepare_staging
      doc_hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(doc_id.to_s)
      staged_path = File.join(@staging_dir, "#{doc_hash}.idx")

      index_entry = {
        id: doc_id,
        content_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content),
        tokens: tokenize(content),
        metadata: metadata,
        indexed_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601
      }

      File.write(staged_path, JSON.generate(index_entry))
      staged_path
    end

    def commit_index
      raise 'Admin access required for commit' unless @acl.can_admin?

      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@index_dir)
      staged_files = Dir.glob(File.join(@staging_dir, '*.idx'))

      staged_files.each do |staged_file|
        target_name = File.basename(staged_file)
        target_path = File.join(@index_dir, target_name)
        promote_staged_file(staged_file, target_path)
      end

      cleanup_staging
      staged_files.length
    end

    def search(query)
      raise 'Read access denied' unless @acl.can_read?

      results = []
      query_tokens = tokenize(query)
      index_files = Dir.glob(File.join(@index_dir, '*.idx'))

      index_files.each do |idx_file|
        entry = JSON.parse(File.read(idx_file), symbolize_names: true)
        score = (query_tokens & entry[:tokens]).length
        results << { id: entry[:id], score: score } if score > 0
      end

      results.sort_by { |r| -r[:score] }
    end

    private

    def promote_staged_file(source, destination)
      # Verify the staged file is a regular file before promotion
      unless File.file?(source) && !File.symlink?(source)
        raise "Staged file invalid or is symlink: #{source}"
      end

      # Read content and write to destination atomically
      content = File.read(source)
      validate_index_entry(content)

      tmp_dest = "#{destination}.#{Process.pid}.tmp"
      File.write(tmp_dest, content)
      File.rename(tmp_dest, destination)
    end

    def validate_index_entry(content)
      entry = JSON.parse(content)
      required = %w[id content_hash tokens indexed_at]
      missing = required - entry.keys
      raise "Invalid index entry, missing: #{missing.join(', ')}" unless missing.empty?
    end

    def cleanup_staging
      FileUtils.rm_rf(@staging_dir)
    end

    def tokenize(text)
      text.to_s.downcase.scan(/[a-z0-9]+/).uniq
    end
  end

  class BatchIndexer
    def initialize(collection_name, user_role)
      @acl = AccessControl.new(user_role)
      @processor = DocumentProcessor.new(collection_name, @acl)
    end

    def index_batch(documents)
      raise 'Write access denied' unless @acl.can_write?

      staged = []
      documents.each do |doc|
        path = @processor.index_document(doc[:id], doc[:content], doc[:metadata] || {})
        staged << path
      end

      if @acl.can_admin?
        committed = @processor.commit_index
        { status: 'committed', count: committed }
      else
        { status: 'staged', count: staged.length, paths: staged }
      end
    end

    def rebuild_index(source_dir)
      raise 'Admin access required' unless @acl.can_admin?

      @processor.prepare_staging

      source_path = resolve_source(source_dir)
      files = Dir.glob(File.join(source_path, '**', '*.json'))

      files.each do |f|
        next if File.symlink?(f)
        doc = JSON.parse(File.read(f), symbolize_names: true)
        @processor.index_document(doc[:id], doc[:content], doc[:metadata] || {})
      end

      @processor.commit_index
    end

    private

    def resolve_source(source_dir)
      # Resolve the real path for the source directory
      resolved = File.expand_path(source_dir)
      # Ensure the resolved path is within allowed boundaries
      allowed_prefixes = [INDEX_BASE, '/var/lib/documents']
      unless allowed_prefixes.any? { |prefix| resolved.start_with?(prefix) }
        raise "Source directory not in allowed path: #{resolved}"
      end
      # Reject if the path itself is a symlink
      if File.symlink?(resolved)
        raise "Source directory is a symlink: #{resolved}"
      end
      resolved
    end
  end
end
